title: Estimating treatment-effect heterogeneity across sites, in multi-site randomized experiments with few units per site
abstract: arXiv:2405.17254v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-site randomized experiments, which are common in economics and medicine, can reveal how treatment effects vary across settings. However, differences between site-specific estimates reflect both treatment-effect heterogeneity and estimation noise. We build on established measurement-error corrections and develop new ones to study this heterogeneity in experiments with many sites and few units per site. In particular, our results can be used to estimate the variance and centered third moment of treatment effects across sites, relate site effects to untreated outcomes, conduct mediation analyses, assess the roles of provider effectiveness and site responsiveness, and study heterogeneity in local average treatment effects (LATEs) under imperfect compliance. translated_title: 在每站点单位数较少的多站点随机实验中估计跨站点处理效应异质性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2405.17254v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：多站点随机实验在经济学和医学中很常见，可以揭示处理效应在不同环境中的变化情况。然而，各站点估计值之间的差异既反映了处理效应的异质性，也反映了估计噪声。我们基于已有的测量误差校正方法并开发了新的方法，来研究站点数量多但每个站点单位数较少的实验中的这种异质性。特别是，我们的结果可用于估计跨站点处理效应的方差和中心化三阶矩，将站点效应与未处理结果联系起来，进行中介分析，评估提供者有效性和站点响应性的作用，并在不完全依从的情况下研究局部平均处理效应（LATE）的异质性。我们将该方法应用于由公共和私营提供者在大约200个法国就业办公室开展的咨询项目，其平均就业收益约为2个百分点。
tldr: 该论文开发了基于测量误差校正的新方法，用于在站点多但每站点样本少的多站点随机实验中估计处理效应的跨站点异质性，并将其成功应用于法国约200个就业办公室的就业咨询项目评估。
en_tdlr: This paper develops new measurement-error corrections to estimate treatment-effect heterogeneity across sites in multi-site randomized experiments with many sites but few units per site, applied to counseling programs in about 200 French employment offices.
